A1.justification: Both PDFs present the same LC-R1 research work. Their main text, equations, tables, figures and Appendices A-D are readable and support a complete comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original LC-R1 benchmark evaluations and reward ablations in Tables 2-3, exploration analyses in Figure 4, and LC-Extractor validation in Appendix B.

after.justification: v2 retains these original benchmark, ablation, exploration and extractor-validation results in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same compressed-trajectory GRPO procedure, Length Reward, Compress Reward and LC-Extractor. No algorithm, model component or objective changes.

E1.justification: Both retain the AIME/MATH training mixture and evaluation on AIME25, MATH500, GSM8K, OlympiadBench, AMC, GPQA-Diamond and LiveCodeBench. The auxiliary VT evaluations, extractor validation and case-study coverage also match.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains the same base models and SFT, DPO, O1-Pruner, ThinkPrune and SFT+O1-Pruner comparisons. Appendix D retains its comparisons with O1-Pruner and the original model.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix C retain the same model sizes, data construction, training settings, metrics and decoding parameters. The main evaluation's 16,384-token limit and Section 5's separate 32,768-token exploration protocol are unchanged.

E4.justification: The reward ablations in Table 3, exploration and per-problem difficulty analyses in Figure 4, extractor validation in Appendix B, and case studies in Figures 7-8 are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both disclose the same evaluation sampling counts: 64 for AIME25, eight for other benchmarks, and 256 for the exploration analysis. Neither adds seed information, repeated-training results, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: Numerical results and plotted findings match throughout. Table 2 retains 46.32% and 51.86% length reductions with 1.84% and 2.14% relative accuracy decreases for the 7B and 1.5B models, respectively. Appendix B retains 98% extractor accuracy.

T1.justification: The VT definition, compression functions, reward formulations and GRPO objective are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, theorems or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about invalid thinking, Brevity and Sufficiency, approximately 50% compression with a 2% accuracy cost, and preservation of exploration and difficulty robustness.

C2.justification: Interpretations of reward complementarity, SFT generalization, exploration preservation and compression across difficulty levels are unchanged. The Impact Statement retains the qualification that LC-R1 validation reaches only the 7B scale because of computational constraints.

D1.justification: The extractor construction and prompt, TRL implementation, four A800-80G GPUs, Table 4 hyperparameters, baseline settings and code-release URL are unchanged. No technical or access information is added.

R1.justification: The introduction, Appendix A and cited works retain the same research positioning. The Llama-Nemotron reference moves fully onto page 10 after the acknowledgment is inserted; it is not a new citation.

P1.justification: v2 adds an Acknowledgment, changes author affiliation markers, replaces the preprint notice with workshop publication information, and removes a redundant clause from the Figure 1 caption. The substantive narrative and appendix prose otherwise match.

P2.justification: The shortened Figure 1 caption and revised first-page publication information cause limited layout changes, while the acknowledgment causes reference reflow on pages 9-10. Scientific graphics, table structures, axes and legends are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 updates publication information, adds an acknowledgment and slightly shortens a caption. The method, empirical evidence, interpretations, limitations and reproducibility material, including the appendices, remain unchanged. These editorial changes do not establish a meaningful overall quality gain or loss.
